If the PortPrototype of the SwComponentPrototype is a PPortPrototype then the CpSoftwareClusterCommunicationResource is provided by the CpSoft- wareCluster . If the PortPrototype of the SwComponentPrototype is a RPortPrototype then the CpSoftwareClusterCommunicationResource is required by the CpSoft- wareCluster .
